title: AgenticControlsReview
description: Second-line review of controls for an agentic AI use case. Authority statement, architecture, tool inventory with blast radius, identity and authorisation, human oversight points with effective-oversight evidence, guardrails, threat assessment (prompt-injection-via-tool-output and tool-misuse), sandbox guarantees, kill switch and rollback with drill records, logging and audit, incident response with regulator-notification triggers, escalation triggers, residual risk, recommended owner actions, source trace. Consumed by genai-pre-prod-review, board-ai-risk-pack, ai-governance-reviewer, the firm cyber incident-response chain, and the model inventory of record.

reviewer_role.description: Function performing the review (e.g., AI Governance Lead, MRMO, second-line cyber).

prompt_injection_review_id.description: Links to prompt-injection-risk output where it has run.

sponsor_function.description: Sponsoring business function (role, never an individual).

authority_statement.description: The agent's authority. Out-of-scope actions are non-optional and require at least three concrete entries.

items.description: Concrete verb against concrete system (e.g., 'place temporary card-lock on a single card on representative-initiated trigger').
Concrete out-of-scope action (e.g., 'no funds movement', 'no permanent card actions', 'no fee adjustments').

financial_impact_per_action.description: Maximum financial-impact framing per action class.

reversibility_per_action.description: Reversibility framing per action class (reversible / partially reversible / irreversible).

multi_agent_topology.description: Planner-executor / specialist-agents / orchestrator pattern; populated when multi_agent is true.

tool_inventory.description: Per tool the agent can invoke. Blast-radius is required on every entry.

system_of_record.description: The system the tool acts on (e.g., card-management platform, retrieval index, outbound-email gateway).

permission.description: Permission level granted to the agent (least-privilege scoping).

blast_radius.description: Concrete worst-case framing if the tool is misused (e.g., 'could cancel up to 50 policies in a single batch', 'could send up to 100 outbound emails per minute').

rate_limit.description: Rate limit at the tool layer in firm policy units.

service_account.description: Agent service-account identifier; separate from any human identity.

scopes.description: Least-privilege scopes assigned to the service account.

secret_management.description: Where credentials live, who can rotate them, who can read them.

human_oversight.description: Human oversight points per consequential decision class. Effective-oversight evidence is required on every entry.

decision_class.description: Concrete class of consequential decision (e.g., 'card-lock-temp action', 'reasoned-denial draft', 'order-routing instruction').

reviewer_role.description: Function performing the oversight (role, never an individual).

sla.description: Time-to-review SLA in firm policy units.

sampling_expectation.description: For post-hoc-sample mode, the sampling rate and audit cadence.

evidence_of_effectiveness.description: Pointer to gate-decision log, sampling audit, drift signal, or other evidence the oversight catches what it is meant to catch. [evidence needed] routes to recommended actions.

guardrails.description: Input filtering, output filtering, refusal behaviour, escalation triggers, structured-output enforcement, content provenance.

threat_assessment.description: Prompt-injection-via-tool-output and tool-misuse attack classes. Each entry names attack class, carrier, and source taxonomy.

attack_class.description: e.g., tool_hijack, cross_scope_tool_query, excessive_agency_chain, planner_executor_seam, multi_agent_message_injection, memory_poisoning, sandbox_escape, direct_prompt_injection, indirect_prompt_injection, jailbreak, exfiltration.

source_taxonomy.description: MITRE ATLAS technique ID, OWASP LLM identifier (LLM01-LLM10), NIST AI 600-1 subcategory, or combination.

tester.description: Firm internal red team, vendor red team, third-party assessor, or [evidence needed].

residual_risk_link.description: Cross-reference to residual_risk[] entry where the failed or partial result is recorded.

sandbox_guarantees.description: Sandbox and execution-environment guarantees. Policy without enforcement evidence routes to recommended actions; do not record as coverage.

enforcement_evidence.description: Evidence that the guarantees are enforced, not policy assertion. [evidence needed] routes to recommended actions.

explicit_no_code_execution_note.description: For tool-use-only systems without execution, name the boundary explicitly rather than omitting.

kill_switch.description: Kill switch and rollback per agent-affecting incident class. Drill record is the load-bearing field.

rto.description: Recovery time objective: how fast the agent goes offline once decision is made.

drill_cadence.description: Required drill cadence per tier; older than cadence flags as gap.

rollback_path.description: How state is reverted, where compensating actions live, who signs off on resumption.

log_content.description: What is logged on every agent invocation, tool call, plan step, oversight event, kill-switch action.

audit_trail_alignment.description: NYDFS Part 500 §500.6, FFIEC IT Handbook, or equivalent named expectations for in-scope entities.

exercised_in_test.description: Confirmed by reading a sample log line, not asserted from policy. False routes to recommended actions.

incident_response.description: Per incident class, the procedure, regulator-notification trigger, and off-switch criterion. Off-switch is non-optional on cyber-relevant and customer-impact-relevant classes.

incident_class.description: e.g., confirmed tool-misuse outside scope, confirmed cross-scope tool query, confirmed external-system unauthorised action, suspected agent compromise, foundation-model behaviour shift, sandbox-escape attempt.

regulator_notification_trigger.description: NYDFS Part 500 §500.17(a) / SEC 8-K Item 1.05 / GLBA Safeguards / state breach laws / 12 CFR 53/225/304 36-hour rule / sector-specific notifications / not applicable.

escalation_triggers.description: Production-monitoring conditions that surface to senior reviewers without waiting for periodic review.

threshold.description: In firm policy units, not 'high' or 'anomalous'.

basis.description: One-line basis for the rating; 'low' without basis is opinion.

accepted_owner_role.description: Role accepting the residual risk; never a named individual.

sector_overlay_notes.description: Sector-specific fields raised by the loaded sector overlay reference doc. The insurance overlay carries the absorbed claims-AI control-bar content.

cross_cutting_overlay_notes.description: Cross-cutting fields raised by the loaded cross-cutting overlay reference doc.

co_acceptors.description: CISO function for cyber-flagged reviews; privacy officer where PHI flows; claims operations leadership for insurance claims AI; sector co-reviewers per overlay.

onward_routing.description: AI risk committee, pre-prod gate, CISO incident-response chain, exam response file, board pack, model inventory of record.
